title: ourisia coccinea
intro: Ourisia coccinea, commonly known as the Scarlet Ourisia, is a flowering plant species native to New Zealand. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ourisia coccinea include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
